summary: The note examines trends in internet service disruptions since September 2023, covering rising frequency, cyberattacks, natural disasters, and impacts on critical sectors, small businesses, education, remote work, and underserved communities. It cites various experts and studies on causes and effects. It closes with government responses, calls for infrastructure investment, and proactive preparedness.
one_line: Overview of rising internet outage trends since September 2023, their causes, societal impacts, and policy, investment, and preparedness responses.
key_facts: Dr. Emily Harris's analysis of October 3rd to December 15th, 2023 found a 5% increase in outages compared to the same period the previous year.
Dr. Emily Harris, a Stanford University cybersecurity professor, attributes the increase to aging infrastructure struggling with growing demand.
On November 8th, 2023, a widespread DDoS attack left thousands in the Northeastern United States without internet for several hours.
Jeremy Linwood, Head of IT at a major New York hospital, said the DDoS attack hampered access to patient records and delayed vital treatments.
After Hurricane Zara, cities like Miami were without internet for days starting December 1st, 2023.
Paul Anderson noted a mid-October outage lasting mere minutes still delayed or lost significant financial transactions, affecting markets globally.
Maria Gonzalez's November 22nd report found service restoration in underserved communities took nearly twice as long as in more affluent neighborhoods.
Tom Chen's study, released January 15th, 2024, found a single day of widespread outages can decrease national productivity measures by up to 0.3%.
Dr. Linda Keating's study, released September 30th, 2023, found outages hinder students' ability to complete coursework on time.
Mark Delaney's e-commerce operations were paralyzed during an October 20th, 2023 outage; he said, "It's about survival."
John M. Patterson, a Federal Communications Commissioner, said in a December 2023 hearing that new policies to mitigate outage impact are under consideration.
David Wang's October 2023 white paper proposes outage preparedness strategies from local backups to community support initiatives.
